name: cryptoslip-sdk-monorepo
description: Official TypeScript SDK (@cryptoslip/sdk) and PocketSlip MCP Server (@cryptoslip/mcp) for CryptoSLIP Protocol V3.2 on Base Mainnet (8453)

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/sdk run build && npm --prefix packages/mcp run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/sdk run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/mcp run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/sdk run lint && npm --prefix packages/mcp run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/sdk test && npm --prefix packages/mcp test
